entry.content: TL;DR: We are enabling the parallel frontend of the Rust compiler on nightly by default,to find remaining issues in preparation for its stabilization.ContextThe Rust compiler has been using multiple threads to compile code in its "backend" part (using LLVM) for a long time. However, its "frontend" part (which includes type checking and borrow checking) has been executing sequentially, on a single thread, which of course limits the performance of the compiler.
